a1-16a.title: Communicative Challenge: Counting to Ten
a1-16a.scenario: Károly is counting the coffees on the table and stops at two.
a1-16a.prompt: Continue counting with three, four, five, then say how many coffees there are.
cues: Say how many coffees there are
a1-16a.target: Három, négy, öt. Öt kávé van.
a1-16a.english: Three, four, five. There are five coffees.
a1-16a.canDo: I can count from zero to ten in Hungarian.

a1-16b.title: Communicative Challenge: Counting Teens
a1-16b.scenario: Károly is counting the books on the shelf: eleven, twelve. Then he asks you to go on.
a1-16b.prompt: Count on with thirteen and fourteen, then say how many books there are.
cues: Say how many books there are
a1-16b.english: Thirteen, fourteen. There are fourteen books.
a1-16b.canDo: I can count from eleven to nineteen in Hungarian.
